scientific_integrity: The lifted regular-simplex construction and the no-contraction branch k<n are credited to van Hintum (2026); the general Schneider-index upper inequality is credited to Fradelizi–Madiman–Marsiglietti–Zvavitch (2018). The distinct contribution is the matching all-order lower witness, exact Hausdorff profile and simultaneous bound saturation.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean norm, unit-circumradius regular simplex, integer n>=2 and k>=1, with 0<epsilon<1/(n-1)^2. This parameter interval is sufficient but not proven maximal; no universal sharp upper contraction coefficient or arbitrary-norm statement is claimed.
title: Exact all-order Hausdorff convexification profile of a raised-simplex set
